title: Repair Cafe – Fix Your Broken Items
summary: Repair Cafe is a community-based initiative that brings together volunteers with repair skills and people who have broken items, enabling them to fix objects together in a social setting rather than discarding them.
problem_solved: Reduces electronic and household waste by fixing broken items instead of throwing them away
why_valuable: Promotes sustainability, reduces landfill waste, saves consumers money, and builds community connections through shared knowledge and skills
